sources.title: NJ Division of Elections, 2024 Official General Election Results, U.S. Senate (official list by county, 12/05/2024)
NJ Division of Elections, 2024 Official General Election Results, U.S. Senate, Mercer County by municipality

method: Mercer County lines were read from the certified state official list (PDF, kept in data/raw/state/2024_NJ_SEN_mercer/; text extracted with pdftotext -raw). Kim (Democratic) is dem, Bashaw (Republican) is rep, and Khalil (Green), Kaplan (Libertarian), Mooneyham (Vote Better) and Kuniansky (Socialist Workers) are oth. The certified NJ list does not report write-ins, so none are included.
validation: Mercer 34021 = official county totals dem 105,685 / rep 46,932 / oth 3,907 (1,620+550+773+964); the municipal-level Mercer PDF totals agree. MIT had dem 80,007 / rep 33,332 (no early-voting rows). Certified statewide: Kim 2,161,491 / Bashaw 1,773,589. With this fill, MIT's other counties plus Mercer give about dem 2,156,960 (-0.21%) / rep 1,771,360 (-0.13%). The remaining gap is outside Mercer: mostly Union 34039 (about 4,100 D / 2,000 R short in MIT) and Atlantic 34001 (about 370 D / 170 R short).
